scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ga/web && npm run typecheck -w @ga/api
scripts.db:local:reset: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U ga_dev -d postgres -c "drop database if exists ga_dev with (force)" -c "create database ga_dev"
scripts.db:local:roles: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U ga_dev -d ga_dev -v pass_migrator=ga_migrator_local_falsa -v pass_app=ga_app_local_falsa -v pass_lectura=ga_lectura_local_falsa < db/bootstrap/roles.sql
scripts.db:local:seed: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U ga_dev -d ga_dev < db/seed/local.sql
